claims.statement: proof.md's algorithm returns x for uniform T=[x]P0 with success >= 0.39 under heuristics H1-H5: z=e(T,Q0) against a randomized base g=e(P0,Q0)^b, the charged field map, a=log_g(z) by the GT STNFS core, ba mod r checked by [ba]P0=T. Core: our valid P18's (a05affb1's re-optimised core: region sized on pool S, judged once on pool G, relations >= 2^63.6232 after a 0.009-bit band charge), clean-run rec7 (RUN_ALLOW 0.00075 from 4,000 a-uniform runs): collection <= 2^118.893348920, N(300)/U 0.03577 (PREREG-H, 2^19/2^20), Horner chains from Krylov checkpoints, small-coefficient unit entries (PREREG-K, 12.50 per vector-entry), linear algebra <= 2^116.586682235 (seven owners), generator <= 2^107.328830867, meter 2^113.279 (success >= 0.39 at +10% descent work); ledger rows sum to at most 2^119.18362037724 <= 2^119.1836203773 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000). All classical work is at most 10 x 2^119.1836203773 + 2^80/2000 < 2^122.505548472187363 G1 units (C=2,000). Storage below 2^106 bytes; no advice or amortization. Analytic exploratory claim.
